words.ex_cn: 昨天温度上升了。
words.en: If an amount or level rises, it increases; if something rises, it moves upwards; if you rise, you stand up; if you rise, you get out of bed.

words.ex: The children play near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边玩耍。
words.en: A river is a large natural stream of water flowing in a channel to the sea, a lake, or another river.

words.ex: The road is long and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 这条路又长又安静。
words.en: A road is a long piece of hard ground which is built between two places so that people can drive or ride easily from one place to the other.

words.ex: The robot cleans the floor every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个机器人每天打扫地板。
words.en: A robot is a machine that is programmed to move and perform certain tasks automatically.

words.tr:
n. 岩石；摇滚乐；
v. （使）摇动；（使）摇晃；
words.ex: The children climbed on the big rock near the river.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在河边的大岩石上攀爬。
words.en: A rock is a large piece of stone that forms part of a hill or mountain. Rock can also refer to a type of music that is loud and has a strong beat. As a verb, to rock means to move gently backwards and forwards or from side to side.

words.ex: The rocket flew into space.
words.ex_cn: 火箭飞入了太空。
words.en: A rocket is a spacecraft, aircraft, or other vehicle that obtains thrust from a rocket engine.

words.ex: He played the role of a teacher in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在电影中扮演了老师的角色。
words.en: The function or position that someone has in a particular situation or activity.

words.tr:
adj. 古罗马的；罗马人的；
n. 古罗马人；
words.ex: The ancient roman roads are still visible today.
words.ex_cn: 古老的罗马道路至今仍清晰可见。
words.en: A Roman is a person who comes from Rome or is connected with Rome. It can also refer to the style of printing or writing that uses upright letters, as opposed to italic.

words.ex: The cat sat on the roof.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在屋顶上。
words.en: The roof of a building is the covering on top of it that protects the people and things inside from the weather.

words.ex: He tied the box with a strong rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根结实的绳子把箱子绑了起来。
words.en: A rope is a thick cord made by twisting together strands of natural fibers such as hemp or artificial fibers such as nylon.

words.tr: n. 玫瑰； v. 上升；提高；“rise”的过去式；
words.ex: She picked a red rose from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 她从花园里摘了一朵红玫瑰。
words.en: A rose is a flower, often with a pleasant smell, which grows on a bush with thorns on the stems.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.ex: The ruler made laws for his people.
words.ex_cn: 这位统治者为他的人民制定法律。
words.en: A ruler is a person who governs or commands. It can also refer to a straight strip or cylinder of plastic, wood, metal, or other rigid material, typically marked at regular intervals and used to draw straight lines or measure distances.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr:
adj. 俄国的；
n. 俄语；
words.ex: He loves Russian music and food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢俄罗斯的音乐和食物。
words.en: Relating to Russia, its people, or their language.

words.ex: He felt sad when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到伤心。
words.en: Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy.

words.ex: The children are playing in a safe park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在安全的公园里玩耍。
words.en: If something or someone is safe, they are not in danger or likely to be harmed.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.ex: I ate a fresh salad for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 我午餐吃了一份新鲜的色拉。
words.en: A salad is a mixture of raw vegetables such as lettuce, cucumber, and tomatoes, often served with a dressing.

words.tr: n. 男推销员；男售货员；
words.ex: The salesman showed us new phones.
words.ex_cn: 那位男推销员给我们展示了新手机。
words.en: A salesman is a man whose job is to sell things, especially directly to shops or other businesses on behalf of a company.

words.ex: She added a little salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她在汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: Salt is a white crystalline substance that is used for seasoning or preserving food. It is also used in various industrial processes.

words.ex: The children built a castle in the sand.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在沙子里建了一座城堡。
words.en: Sand is a substance that consists of very small grains of rock, found on beaches and in deserts.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.ex: He ate a sausage for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一根香肠。
words.en: A sausage is a type of meat product usually made from ground meat, often pork, beef, or poultry, along with salt, spices, and other flavorings. Other ingredients such as grains or breadcrumbs may be included as fillers or extenders.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: The scientist studies stars in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家研究夜空中的恒星。
words.en: A scientist is someone who has studied science and whose job is to teach or do research in science.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.ex: The secretary types letters for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 秘书为经理打字。
words.en: A secretary is a person whose job is to do office work, such as typing letters, answering phone calls, and arranging meetings.

words.tr:
n. 种子；籽；
v. 播种；
words.ex: The farmer planted the seed in the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫把种子种在土里。
words.en: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

words.ex: He learned to love his self.
words.ex_cn: 他学会了爱自己。
words.en: Your self is your basic personality or nature, especially considered in terms of what you are really like as a person.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.ex: This sentence is easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子很容易理解。
words.en: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

words.ex: He was born in September.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在九月。
words.en: September is the ninth month of the year in the Gregorian calendar, coming after August and before October.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；认真的；严肃的；
words.ex: The accident caused a serious injury.
words.ex_cn: 这次事故造成了严重的伤害。
words.en: If you are serious about something, you are sincere about it and mean what you say.

words.ex: The servant cleaned the house every morning.
words.ex_cn: 仆人每天早上打扫房子。
words.en: A servant is someone who is employed to work in another person's house, doing jobs such as cooking and cleaning.

words.tr:
n. 服务；
v. 保养；
words.ex: The restaurant offers excellent service.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅提供出色的服务。
words.en: The act of helping or doing work for someone; a system that provides something the public needs, such as transport, communications, or utilities.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.ex: She sews a dress for her daughter.
words.ex_cn: 她为女儿缝制一件连衣裙。
words.en: To join, fasten, or repair something by making stitches with a needle and thread or a sewing machine.

words.ex: He learned about sex in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学到了性。
words.en: Sex refers to the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences rather than biological ones.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.ex: The tree casts a long shadow at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 夕阳下，树投下长长的影子。
words.en: A shadow is a dark shape on a surface that is made when something stands between a light and the surface.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.ex: He wrote his name on a sheet of paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在一张纸上写了名字。
words.en: A sheet is a large piece of thin cloth used on a bed to lie on or under. It can also refer to a flat, thin piece of material, such as paper, metal, or glass.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.ex: The children played on the shore of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在湖岸玩耍。
words.en: The land along the edge of a sea, lake, or other large body of water.

words.ex: His main shortcoming is being late often.
words.ex_cn: 他的主要缺点是经常迟到。
words.en: A shortcoming is a fault or a failure to meet a certain standard, which means a person or thing is not as good as they should be.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: He shouted for help when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时大叫着求救。
words.en: If you shout, you say something very loudly, usually because you want people a long distance away to hear you or because you are angry.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.ex: The shy boy didn't speak in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个害羞的男孩在课堂上没有说话。
words.en: If you are shy, you are nervous and uncomfortable in the company of other people.

words.ex: He is sick and cannot go to school.
words.ex_cn: 他生病了，不能去上学。
words.en: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick can also mean feeling nauseous or wanting to vomit. Additionally, it can describe being very tired of something or someone because you have experienced too much of them.

words.ex: The cat sat on the side of the bed.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在床的旁边。
words.en: One of the two or more parts or areas into which something is divided, or one of the two surfaces of something flat and thin, such as paper.

words.tr:
v. 叹息；叹气
n. 叹息；叹气
words.ex: He sighed when he saw the messy room.
words.ex_cn: 他看到凌乱的房间时叹了口气。
words.en: To sigh is to let out a deep breath slowly and audibly, often as a sign of sadness, tiredness, or relief.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.ex: We went sightseeing in Paris last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去巴黎观光了。
words.en: The activity of visiting places of interest in a particular location.

words.ex: There was silence after the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 坏消息传来后，一片沉默。
words.en: The absence of sound; complete quiet.

words.ex: The children were silent during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在看电影时很安静。
words.en: Someone or something that is silent makes no noise at all.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.ex: His silly hat made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 他那可笑的帽子让大家都笑了。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is silly, you mean that they are foolish, childish, or ridiculous.

words.ex: A sliver of wood stuck in his finger.
words.ex_cn: 一小片木头扎进了他的手指。
words.en: A sliver is a small, thin piece of something that has been cut, broken, or torn off from a larger piece.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.ex: He likes to skate on the ice every winter.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每年冬天在冰上溜冰。
words.en: To move over a surface on skates, or to perform a sport that involves moving on skates.

words.ex: The sun burned his skin.
words.ex_cn: 太阳晒伤了他的皮肤。
words.en: Your skin is the natural outer covering of your body.

words.ex: She wore a red skirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色短裙去参加派对。
words.en: A skirt is a piece of clothing that hangs from the waist and covers part or all of the legs. It can also refer to the edge or border of something, or to the act of moving along the edge of something.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.tr:
n. 睡眠；
v. 睡觉；
words.ex: He needs more sleep to feel better.
words.ex_cn: 他需要更多的睡眠来感觉好些。
words.en: Sleep is the natural state of rest in which your eyes are closed, your body is inactive, and your mind is unconscious.

words.ex: He rolled up his sleeve to wash his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他卷起袖子洗手。
words.en: The part of a garment that covers the arm.

words.tr:
n. 短袜；重击
v. 猛打
words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving for school.
words.ex_cn: 他上学前穿上了短袜。
words.en: A sock is a piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of cotton or wool.

words.ex: The pillow is soft and comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 这个枕头很软，很舒服。
words.en: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

words.ex: The farmer planted corn in rich soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民在肥沃的土壤里种了玉米。
words.en: Soil is the substance on the surface of the earth in which plants grow, consisting of rock and mineral particles mixed with decayed organic matter.

words.ex: The soldier walks to the camp every morning.
words.ex_cn: 士兵每天早上步行去营地。
words.en: A soldier is a person who serves in an army.

words.tr:
adj. 固体的；坚固的；可靠的；
n. 固体；
words.ex: Ice is a solid form of water.
words.ex_cn: 冰是水的固体形式。
words.en: A solid substance or object stays the same shape whether it is in a container or not.

words.tr: adv. 以某种方式；不知何故；
words.ex: Somehow, he finished the race despite the injury.
words.ex_cn: 不知怎么的，他尽管受伤了还是完成了比赛。
words.en: You use somehow to say that you do not know or cannot say how something was done or will be done.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东南方向。
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.ex: He lives in the southern part of the city.
words.ex_cn: 他住在城市的南部。
words.en: Located in or characteristic of a region in the south.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr:
n. 西班牙语；
adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的；
words.ex: He speaks spanish fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲西班牙语。
words.en: Of or relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

words.ex: He gave a short speech at the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议上做了一个简短的讲话。
words.en: Speech is the expression of or the ability to express thoughts and feelings by articulate sounds.

words.tr:
v. 拼写；意味着；
n. 一段时间；
words.ex: Can you spell your name?
words.ex_cn: 你能拼出你的名字吗？
words.en: If you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the correct order.

words.tr: n. 拼写；拼法； v. “spell”的现在分词；
words.ex: His spelling is very poor.
words.ex_cn: 他的拼写很差。
words.en: The forming of words from letters according to accepted usage; orthography.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.tr: n. 运动员；爱好运动的人
words.ex: He is a true sportsman who never cheats.
words.ex_cn: 他是个真正的运动员，从不作弊。
words.en: A sportsman is a man who takes part in sports, especially as a professional.

words.tr:
n. 平方；广场；正方形；四方形；
adj. 正方形的；四方形的；平方的；成直角的；
v. 与...一致；
adv. 成直角地；
words.ex: The area of the room is 16 square.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的面积是16平方米。
words.en: A square is a shape with four sides of equal length and four angles of 90 degrees. It can also refer to an open area in a town, often used for public events, or to the result of multiplying a number by itself.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: He walked up the stair to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯到了二楼。
words.en: A set of steps leading from one floor of a building to another, typically inside the building.

words.ex: He put a stamp on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他在信封上贴了一张邮票。
words.en: A stamp is a small piece of paper which you stick on an envelope or package before you post it to pay for the cost of the postage. It can also mean to bring down your foot heavily on the ground or to impress a pattern or mark on a surface.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.ex: The statesman spoke wisely to calm the nation.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家明智地讲话以安抚国家。
words.en: A statesman is a respected political leader or figure, especially one who has had a long and successful career in politics.

words.ex: He stole a book from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店偷了一本书。
words.en: To take something that belongs to someone else without their permission and without intending to return it.

words.ex: The kettle produces steam when the water boils.
words.ex_cn: 水烧开时，水壶会产生蒸汽。
words.en: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. It can be used to power machines or to cook food.

words.ex: The steamer sailed across the river.
words.ex_cn: 汽船驶过了河。
words.en: A steamer is a ship or boat that is powered by steam engines. It can also refer to a kitchen utensil used for steaming food.

words.ex: He ate too much and his stomach hurt.
words.ex_cn: 他吃太多了，胃疼。
words.en: The stomach is the organ in your body where food is digested after you have eaten it.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.tr:
n. 商店；店铺；仓库；储存；
v. 贮藏；存储；
words.ex: I bought milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 我在商店买了牛奶。
words.en: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, a store is a large shop that sells many different kinds of goods. In American English, a store is any kind of shop.

words.ex: The storm broke out at night.
words.ex_cn: 暴风雨在夜间爆发了。
words.en: A storm is very bad weather, with heavy rain, strong winds, and often thunder and lightning.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.ex: The house has three storeys.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子有三层。
words.en: A storey is a level of a building; a floor.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: He wore a strange hat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他戴了一顶奇怪的帽子去学校。
words.en: If something is strange, it is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

words.tr: n. 新来者；陌生人； adj. “strange”的比较级；
words.ex: He is a stranger in this town.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个镇上的新来者。
words.en: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

words.ex: The cow eats straw from the barn.
words.ex_cn: 牛吃谷仓里的稻草。
words.en: A straw is a thin tube of paper or plastic that you use to suck a drink into your mouth.

words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.ex: The children play on the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在街上玩耍。
words.en: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses and buildings on one or both sides.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: He made a stupid mistake on the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中犯了一个愚蠢的错误。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is stupid, you mean that they show a lack of good judgment or intelligence and they are not at all sensible.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.tr:
adj. 这样的；如此的；
pron. 这样的人或事；
words.ex: He made such a big mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了这样的大错。
words.en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce examples of the thing or person that you have just mentioned.

words.ex: He put sugar in his tea.
words.ex_cn: 他把糖放进茶里。
words.en: A sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of white or brown crystals.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.ex: We go to the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期天去公园。
words.en: Sunday is the day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

words.ex: Plants grow better with sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 植物在阳光下生长得更好。
words.en: Sunlight is the light that comes from the sun.

words.ex: The children play in the sunshine.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阳光下玩耍。
words.en: Sunshine is the light and heat that comes from the sun.

words.tr:
v. 支持；支撑；
n. 拥护；帮助；
words.ex: My friends support me when I feel sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我感到难过时，我的朋友们支持我。
words.en: If you support someone or their ideas or aims, you agree with them, and perhaps help them because you want them to succeed.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他明天会来。
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.tr:
n. 表面；
v. 显露；
words.ex: The surface of the table is smooth.
words.ex_cn: 桌子的表面很光滑。
words.en: The outer or top part of something; to rise to the surface of water or to become known after being hidden or secret.

words.tr:
n. 惊讶；意外；惊喜；
v. 使惊奇；使感到意外；
words.ex: She felt a surprise when she saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到礼物时，感到很惊讶。
words.en: If something surprises you, it happens unexpectedly and causes you to feel surprise.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.ex: He told a tale about a brave knight.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了一个关于勇敢骑士的故事。
words.en: A tale is a story, especially one that is full of exciting or magical events.

words.ex: He filled the tank with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把罐子装满了水。
words.en: A tank is a large container for holding liquid or gas, or a heavily armored fighting vehicle carrying guns and moving on a continuous articulated metal track.

words.tr:
v. 利用；
n. 水龙头；轻拍；轻敲；轻击；
words.ex: The company tapped local talent to grow its business.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司利用本地人才来发展业务。
words.en: If you tap something, you hit it with a quick light blow or a series of quick light blows. A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.

words.tr: n. 磁带；录音带；胶带；带子；
words.ex: He recorded the song on a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他把这首歌录在磁带上。
words.en: A tape is a narrow strip of plastic or other material that is used for recording sound or pictures, or for sticking things together.

words.ex: He finished his homework task before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了他的作业任务。
words.en: A task is a piece of work to be done or undertaken.

words.tr:
n. 税；税款；
v. 对...征税；
words.ex: He pays tax every year.
words.ex_cn: 他每年缴税。
words.en: A tax is a sum of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

words.tr: n. （十三到十九岁的）青少年
words.ex: The teenager walks to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个青少年每天步行上学。
words.en: A teenager is someone who is between thirteen and nineteen years old.

words.ex: He picked up the telephone to call his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起电话给妈妈打电话。
words.en: A telephone is a device that you use to speak to someone in another place by dialing a number. It converts sound into electrical signals that can be sent over long distances.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: He plays tennis every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末打网球。
words.en: Tennis is a game played by two or four players on a rectangular court, in which a ball is hit back and forth over a net using rackets.

words.ex: They slept in a tent during the camping trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在露营时睡在帐篷里。
words.en: A tent is a portable shelter made of fabric or other material stretched over a supporting framework of poles and usually stabilized or secured to the ground with cords and stakes.

words.tr:
n. 术语；学期；期限；措辞；
v. 把…称作；把…叫做；
words.ex: The word 'algorithm' is a technical term in computer science.
words.ex_cn: ‘算法’是计算机科学中的一个术语。
words.en: A term is a word or expression used in relation to a particular subject, especially one that has a specific meaning, or a fixed period of time during which something lasts or is intended to happen.

words.ex: He bought a new textbook for math class.
words.ex_cn: 他为数学课买了一本新教科书。
words.en: A textbook is a book containing a comprehensive compilation of content in a branch of study with the intention of explaining it. Textbooks are produced to meet the needs of educators, usually at educational institutions.

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.ex: He is thirsty after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后口渴了。
words.en: If you are thirsty, you feel a need to drink something.

words.ex: She picked up a thread from the fabric.
words.ex_cn: 她从布料上捡起一根线。
words.en: A thread is a long, thin strand of cotton, nylon, or other fibers used in sewing or weaving. It can also refer to a theme or idea that connects parts of a story or discussion.

words.ex: He had a sore throat after singing all night.
words.ex_cn: 他唱了一整晚后喉咙疼。
words.en: Your throat is the back part of your mouth, where it connects to your neck. It includes the passage that leads from your mouth to your stomach and lungs.

words.ex: We heard thunder during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴期间我们听到了雷声。
words.en: the loud noise that you hear during a storm, usually after a flash of lightning

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期四有一个会议。
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张电影票。
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.tr: adj. 极小的；微小的；微量的；
words.ex: The tiny ant carried a big leaf.
words.ex_cn: 这只极小的蚂蚁搬着一片大叶子。
words.en: Very small in size or amount.

words.ex: The book has a long title.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个很长的标题。
words.en: A title is a name that describes someone's position or job, or a word or phrase that is used to describe a book, film, play, etc.

words.ex: He smokes tobacco every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吸烟草。
words.en: Tobacco is a plant that is grown for its leaves, which are dried and used for smoking in cigarettes, cigars, and pipes, or for chewing or snuffing.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天一起工作。
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: He lifted a ton of bricks yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天搬了一吨砖。
words.en: A ton is a unit of weight equal to 2,240 pounds in Britain and 2,000 pounds in the United States. It is also used informally to mean a large amount of something.

words.ex: He speaks Chinese as his mother tongue.
words.ex_cn: 他把汉语作为母语。
words.en: The tongue is the flexible muscular organ in the mouth that is used for tasting, licking, swallowing, and (in humans) articulating speech.

words.tr:
adv. 在今晚；
n. 今晚；
words.ex: We will have dinner together tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我们今晚一起吃晚饭。
words.en: Tonight refers to the evening or night of the current day.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful tool for fixing things.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是修理东西的有用工具。
words.en: A tool is any instrument or simple piece of equipment that you hold in your hands and use to do a particular kind of work.

words.ex: He brushed his tooth after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后刷了牙。
words.en: One of the hard, white objects in the mouth that are used for biting and chewing.

words.ex: The topic of our talk is climate change.
words.ex_cn: 我们谈话的话题是气候变化。
words.en: A topic is a particular subject that you discuss or write about.

words.tr: n. 旅游；游览；巡回活动；
words.ex: We went on a tour of Paris last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天我们去巴黎旅游了。
words.en: A tour is a journey in which you visit several places that interest you, especially on holiday.

words.ex: The tourist took photos at the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅游者在博物馆拍照。
words.en: A tourist is a person who is visiting a place for pleasure and interest, especially when they are on holiday.

words.ex: He walked toward the door.
words.ex_cn: 他朝门走去。
words.en: In the direction of; in relation to; near to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He walked towards the park.
words.ex_cn: 他朝公园走去。
words.en: In the direction of; with a tendency to; in relation to; for the purpose of.

words.ex: He dried his hands with a towel.
words.ex_cn: 他用毛巾擦干手。
words.en: A towel is a piece of thick soft cloth that you use to dry yourself with.

words.tr:
n. 塔；塔楼；
v. 高耸；
words.ex: The tower stands tall in the center of the city.
words.ex_cn: 这座塔矗立在城市中心。
words.en: A tower is a tall, narrow building, either part of a larger building such as a church or castle, or standing alone.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.ex: The traffic on the highway was very heavy this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上高速公路上的交通非常拥堵。
words.en: Traffic refers to the movement of vehicles or people along roads, or to the movement of aircraft, ships, or trains. It can also refer to the trade or exchange of goods or services, especially illegal ones.

words.tr: n. 培训；训练；锻炼； v. “train”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company provided free training for new employees.
words.ex_cn: 公司为新员工提供了免费培训。
words.en: The process of learning the skills you need to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
n. 珍宝；宝物；财富；
v. 珍惜；
words.ex: The old map showed where the treasure was buried.
words.ex_cn: 那张旧地图显示了珍宝埋藏的地方。
words.en: If you treasure something that you have, you keep it or care for it carefully because it gives you great pleasure and you think it is very special.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.ex: The troop marched into the town at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 部队在黎明时分进入城镇。
words.en: A troop is a group of soldiers or a large group of people or animals.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.ex: He wears blue trousers to work.
words.ex_cn: 他上班穿蓝色的裤子。
words.en: Trousers are a piece of clothing that you wear over your body from the waist downwards, and that cover each leg separately.

words.ex: The truck carried boxes to the store.
words.ex_cn: 卡车把箱子运到了商店。
words.en: A truck is a large vehicle that is used to transport goods by road.

words.tr:
n. 信任；信赖；
v. 信任；信赖；
words.ex: I have trust in my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友。
words.en: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

words.ex: The truth is that he was late for work.
words.ex_cn: 事实是他上班迟到了。
words.en: The truth is the true facts about something, rather than what is imagined or invented.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期二有一个会议。
words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.ex: He finished in twelfth place in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第十二名。
words.en: The ordinal number matching the number twelve in a series.

words.ex: I visited my grandparents twice last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年我去了祖父母家两次。
words.en: Two times; on two occasions.

words.tr:
n. 双胞胎之一；
adj. 成对的；
words.ex: He has a twin brother who looks exactly like him.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个和他长得一模一样的双胞胎兄弟。
words.en: One of two children or animals born at the same birth; to pair or match closely.

words.ex: He typed the letter on an old typewriter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一台旧打字机打了这封信。
words.en: A typewriter is a machine with keys that you press to print letters, numbers, or other characters onto paper.

words.ex: She is a fast typist.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位打字很快的打字员。
words.en: A typist is someone who types, especially as their job.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.tr:
adj. 地下的；
n. 地铁；地下；
adv. 在地下；
words.ex: The underground tunnel connects two buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这条地下的隧道连接了两座建筑。
words.en: Something that is underground is below the surface of the ground. It can also refer to secret activities or organizations.

words.ex: This box weighs one unit.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子重一单位。
words.en: A unit is a single thing or person that is part of something larger.

words.ex: He goes to university to study engineering.
words.ex_cn: 他上大学学习工程。
words.en: A university is an institution where students study for degrees and where academic research is done.

words.ex: He will call you upon his arrival.
words.ex_cn: 他一到就会给你打电话。
words.en: On or onto a surface or position above or on top of something.

words.ex: The upper shelf is too high to reach.
words.ex_cn: 上面的架子太高了，够不着。
words.en: Higher in place or position; situated above another part.

words.ex: He went upstairs to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他上楼去睡觉了。
words.en: If you go upstairs in a building, you go up a staircase towards a higher floor.

words.tr: v. 使用；利用；“use”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 习惯的；使用过的；二手的；
words.ex: He used a pen to write the letter.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支笔写了这封信。
words.en: Previously owned by someone else; second-hand.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 她通常走路去学校。
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.ex: We went to the beach during our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们在假期去了海滩。
words.en: A vacation is a period of time devoted to pleasure, rest, or relaxation, especially one with pay granted to an employee.

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.ex: I eat carrot and broccoli every day as vegetable.
words.ex_cn: 我每天吃胡萝卜和西兰花作为蔬菜。
words.en: A vegetable is a plant or part of a plant that is used as food, typically as accompaniment to meat or fish, such as a cabbage, potato, carrot, or bean.

words.ex: In the sentence 'She runs', 'runs' is a verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子 'She runs' 中，'runs' 是一个动词。
words.en: A word that is used to describe an action, state, or occurrence, and forming the main part of the predicate of a sentence, such as 'run', 'become', or 'happen'.

words.ex: The team celebrated their victory after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，球队庆祝了他们的胜利。
words.en: A victory is a success in a struggle, war, or competition.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: The war ended last year.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争去年结束了。
words.en: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.ex_cn: 太阳给我们温暖的光。
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.ex: I wash my hands before eating.
words.ex_cn: 我吃饭前洗手。
words.en: To clean something using water and usually soap.

words.tr:
n. 垃圾；废物；浪费；
v. 浪费；白费；糟蹋；
adj. 荒芜的；废弃的；
words.ex: The children threw waste into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: If you waste something such as time, money, or energy, you use too much of it doing something that is not important or necessary, or you do not use it in a sensible way.

words.tr: n. 方式；道路；方向；路线；方法；
words.ex: He found a new way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一种解决这个问题的新方式。
words.en: A way is a method, style, or manner of doing something, or a route or path that you take to get from one place to another.

words.ex: He feels weak after the long illness.
words.ex_cn: 这场大病之后，他感到虚弱。
words.en: If someone is weak, they are not physically strong or healthy.

words.ex: His weakness made him unable to fight back.
words.ex_cn: 他的软弱使他无法反击。
words.en: A weakness is a fault or lack of strength in someone's character or in a system, plan, or design.

words.tr:
v. 穿；戴；
n. 磨损；衣着；
words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: If you wear something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery, you have them on your body or on part of your body.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Wednesday.
words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: Call me whenever you need help.
words.ex_cn: 无论何时你需要帮助，就给我打电话。
words.en: at any or every time that

words.ex: You can leave your bag wherever you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以把包放在任何你喜欢的地方。
words.en: in or to any place; in any case or situation

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.tr:
adj. 广泛的；宽的；宽阔的；
adv. 广大地；
words.ex: The book has wide use in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side to the other.

words.ex: He bought a flower for his wife.
words.ex_cn: 他为他的妻子买了一朵花。
words.en: A wife is a married woman considered in relation to her husband.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.tr:
v. 赢；获得；
n. 胜利；赢得；
words.ex: I want to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 我想赢这场比赛。
words.en: to achieve first position and/or get a prize in a competition, election, fight, etc.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.ex: He drinks wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他吃饭时喝葡萄酒。
words.en: An alcoholic drink made from fermented grape juice.

words.ex: The winner got a gold medal.
words.ex_cn: 优胜者获得了一枚金牌。
words.en: A winner is a person or thing that wins something.

words.ex: The birds fly south in winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，鸟儿飞向南方。
words.en: Winter is the season between autumn and spring. In the winter, the weather is usually cold.

words.tr: adj. 充满智慧的；明智的；英明的；
words.ex: The wise old man gave good advice.
words.ex_cn: 这位充满智慧的老人给出了很好的建议。
words.en: If you describe someone as wise, you mean that they have experience, knowledge, and good judgment.

words.ex: The keys are within the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙在抽屉里。
words.en: If something is within a place, area, or object, it is inside it or surrounded by it.

words.ex: He cannot swim without water.
words.ex_cn: 没有水，他不会游泳。
words.en: If you do something without something else, you do not have that thing with you or you do not use that thing.

words.ex: The wolf howled at the moon.
words.ex_cn: 狼对着月亮嚎叫。
words.en: A wolf is a wild animal that is related to the dog and lives and hunts in groups.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.ex: The house is built with wood.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子是用木材建造的。
words.en: Wood is the material which forms the trunks and branches of trees. It is used for building and making things.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.tr:
n. 工作；活计；作品；制作品；
v. （使）工作；（使）运转；操作；经营；起作用；
words.ex: He finds his work very meaningful.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得他的工作很有意义。
words.en: Work is an activity in which you use effort in order to do a task or achieve a result.

words.ex: The workman fixed the roof with tools.
words.ex_cn: 工人用工具修好了屋顶。
words.en: A workman is a man who works with his hands, especially in a skilled job.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 更坏的；更糟糕的；“bad”的比较级； adv. 更糟；更坏；
words.ex: The weather got worse after noon.
words.ex_cn: 下午之后天气变得更坏了。
words.en: Comparative of bad : more unpleasant, difficult, or severe than before or than something else that is also bad

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.ex: Is this your book?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书吗？
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是你的。
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.tr: phrase. 是…的原因；解释；负责；（数量或比例上）占
words.ex: The rain can account for the delay.
words.ex_cn: 下雨是延误的原因。
words.en: If a particular thing accounts for a part or proportion of something, that part or proportion consists of that thing, or is used or produced by it.

words.ex: He is all over the place today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天到处跑。
words.en: In every part of a place; everywhere.

words.ex: He studied hard, and yet he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习了，但他还是没通过考试。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that contrasts with or seems to contradict something that has been said previously

words.ex: As a rule, he walks to school.
words.ex_cn: 通常，他走路去学校。
words.en: If you say that something happens as a rule, you mean that it usually happens.

words.ex: The class, as a whole, did well on the test.
words.ex_cn: 整个班级在考试中表现不错。
words.en: Considering all parts or elements together; as a single unit.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.ex: He asks for help when he is stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当他遇到困难时，他会寻求帮助。
words.en: To request something; to express a desire for something.

words.ex: I associate with him because we share the same hobbies.
words.ex_cn: 我跟他联系是因为我们有相同的爱好。
words.en: to spend time with someone, especially someone that other people disapprove of

words.ex: He can eat one apple at a time.
words.ex_cn: 他一次只能吃一个苹果。
words.en: Indicates the number of items or actions that are involved in a single instance or occurrence.

words.tr: 短语. 轻松的；不拘束的；稍息（军事口令）
words.ex: He feels at ease when he is with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 当他和朋友在一起时，他感到轻松自在。
words.en: If you are at ease, you are feeling confident and relaxed, and are able to talk to people without feeling nervous or awkward.

words.ex: At one time, he played soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 曾经，他每天踢足球。
words.en: If something was the case at one time, it was the case during a particular period in the past.

words.ex: At present, he is working as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 目前，他是一名老师。
words.en: At the present time; now.

words.tr: 短语. 静止的；休息中；平静的
words.ex: The object remains at rest until a force acts upon it.
words.ex_cn: 物体在受到力的作用之前保持静止。
words.en: If something is at rest, it is not moving.

words.tr: phrase. 突然离开； 突然挣脱；决裂； 退出
words.ex: He broke away from the group and ran home.
words.ex_cn: 他突然离开团队，跑回家了。
words.en: To leave or escape from a person, group, or situation that controls or restricts you.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 闯入；打断；（使）逐渐适用
words.ex: Thieves broke in through the back door.
words.ex_cn: 小偷从后门闯入。
words.en: To enter a building by force, especially in order to steal something; to interrupt a conversation or activity.

words.ex: The thief tried to break into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷试图在夜里闯入房子。
words.en: To enter a building or car using force, in order to steal something; to suddenly start doing something.

words.tr: 短语，通常用于 'break of dawn' 或 'break of day'，意为黎明时分，天刚破晓的时候
words.ex: The day began with the break of dawn.
words.ex_cn: 天在破晓时分开始。
words.en: A pause or interruption in a continuous activity or process.

words.tr: phrase. 中断；突然停止；断绝（关系）；休息一会
words.ex: He broke off the conversation when the phone rang.
words.ex_cn: 电话响时，他中断了对话。
words.en: To suddenly stop doing something, especially speaking.

words.ex: The fire broke out in the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 火在厨房里突然烧了起来。
words.en: If something such as war, fighting, or disease breaks out, it begins suddenly.

words.ex: He broke through the wall with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他用手打破了墙壁。
words.en: To break through means to make a way through a barrier or to achieve success in spite of difficulties.

words.tr: phrase. 打碎；分裂；解体；结束；期终放假
words.ex: He broke up the ice with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把冰打碎了。
words.en: To end a relationship or to disintegrate into pieces.

words.ex: The smell of cookies brings to mind my childhood.
words.ex_cn: 饼干的香味让我想起了我的童年。
words.en: To cause someone to remember or think of something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （使建筑物等）烧毁；烧成平地
words.ex: The old house burned down in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 那座老房子在火灾中被烧毁了。
words.en: If a building burns down or if someone burns it down, it is completely destroyed by fire.

words.ex: He burns for justice.
words.ex_cn: 他渴望正义。
words.en: To have a strong desire or longing for something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 燃烧掉；消耗掉（多余的脂肪或能量）
words.ex: They decided to burn off the old furniture instead of selling it.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定烧掉旧家具，而不是卖掉它。
words.en: To remove something by burning, or to use energy by doing exercise.

words.tr: phrase. 尽一切办法；务必；一定
words.ex: You can borrow my book by all means.
words.ex_cn: 你当然可以借我的书。
words.en: used to give permission or to say that you are willing to allow something to happen

words.tr: phrase. 不久以后；逐渐地；迟早
words.ex: By and by, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
words.ex_cn: 渐渐地，雨停了，太阳出来了。
words.en: After some time; eventually.

words.ex: He laughs and cries by turns.
words.ex_cn: 他一会儿笑，一会儿哭。
words.en: If people do something by turns, they do it one after the other in a repeated order.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 责骂；斥责；使降低
words.ex: The teacher called down the student for being late.
words.ex_cn: 老师斥责了迟到的学生。
words.en: To cause something, especially something unpleasant, to happen.

words.tr: phrase. 呼吁；号召；要求；接（人）
words.ex: The situation calls for immediate action.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况需要立即采取行动。
words.en: If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr: phrase. 叫（某人）进来；召来；来访
words.ex: He called in a doctor for his sick son.
words.ex_cn: 他为生病的儿子请了一位医生。
words.en: To request someone's presence or participation, especially by telephone.

words.tr: phrase. 取消；转移；叫走；依次叫名
words.ex: They decided to call off the meeting because of the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们因为风暴决定取消会议。
words.en: To cancel or abandon something that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call on my grandma this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我将去拜访我的奶奶。
words.en: To visit someone; to formally ask or request someone to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 给…打电话；使想起；召集
words.ex: He called up his friend to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他给朋友打电话问好。
words.en: To telephone someone; to summon someone to military service; to bring something back to one's mind.

words.tr: phrase. 拜访；要求；呼吁；号召
words.ex: I will call upon my grandmother this weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这个周末我会去拜访我的祖母。
words.en: To call upon someone is to ask them to do something or to use something that they can offer.

words.ex: The sun comes into the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳早上照进房间里。
words.en: To enter a place, state, or condition; to inherit something; to begin to be involved in something.

words.tr: phrasal verb. （在重要性、价值或影响方面）有作用，有影响，有价值：to be important or have value or influence
words.ex: In the end, love and kindness count for everything.
words.ex_cn: 最终，爱和善良意味着一切。
words.en: To be of value or importance.

words.tr: phrase. 献身于； 把...专用于；致力于…
words.ex: He devotes to helping poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他献身于帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: To give all or a large part of one's time or resources to (a person, activity, or cause).

words.tr: phrase. 要么……要么……；不是……就是……（用于连接两个选择）
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选择茶或咖啡。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: I will go for a walk even if it rains.
words.ex_cn: 即使下雨，我也会去散步。
words.en: You use 'even if' to say that something is true or happens although something else might prevent it.

words.ex: He went out even though it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use even though to introduce a clause which gives the reason for something, but which makes the reason seem less important or significant.

words.ex: Everyone came to the party except for Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加派对了。
words.en: You use except for to introduce the only thing or person that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.tr: phrase. 除了……之外；只是（用于引出例外或限制条件）
words.ex: I like the movie, except that the ending is too fast.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢这部电影，只是结局太快了。
words.en: used to introduce a statement that makes a situation or condition seem less true or less important

words.ex: He went out for all it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 尽管在下雨，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite; used to introduce a fact that makes the main statement in your sentence very surprising

words.tr: phrase. 尽管如此；虽然那样
words.ex: For all that he has achieved, he remains humble.
words.ex_cn: 尽管他取得了成就，他仍然保持谦逊。
words.en: Despite that; nevertheless.

words.ex: He left early for fear of missing the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早早离开，怕赶不上公交车。
words.en: If you do something for fear of something else, you do it to avoid that other thing happening.

words.tr: phrase. 下来；吞下；弯下；写下
words.ex: He got down from the chair slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地从椅子上下来。
words.en: To move from a higher to a lower position; to write something down; to cause someone to feel sad or depressed.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；到达；插话；收割；当选
words.ex: He gets in the car every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上上车。
words.en: To arrive at a place, especially after a journey.

words.tr: phrase. 进入；陷入；染上（坏习惯）
words.ex: He wants to get into a good university.
words.ex_cn: 他想进入一所好大学。
words.en: To enter or become involved in a particular activity, situation, or state.

words.ex: He got over his cold last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周康复了。
words.en: To recover from something, such as an illness or a shock; to overcome a problem or difficulty.

words.ex: I get up at seven o'clock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上七点起床。
words.en: To rise from bed after sleeping; to stand up; to increase in amount or level.

words.ex: He gave up smoking last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年戒烟了。
words.en: If you give up something, you stop doing it or having it.

words.ex: He goes after his dreams every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天追求自己的梦想。
words.en: To pursue or chase someone or something, often with the intention of catching or achieving them.

words.ex: Time goes by quickly when you are happy.
words.ex_cn: 当你开心时，时间过得很快。
words.en: If you say that time goes by, you mean that it passes.

words.tr: phrase. 选择；追求；努力争取
words.ex: I want to go for the blue shirt.
words.ex_cn: 我对那件蓝色的衬衫感兴趣。
words.en: If you go for something, you choose it or try to achieve it.

words.ex: He goes into the room quietly.
words.ex_cn: 他悄悄地进入房间。
words.en: To enter a place, to start doing something as a job or activity, to investigate or examine something, or to discuss something in detail.

words.ex: He goes on talking even when no one listens.
words.ex_cn: 即使没人听，他还是继续说。
words.en: To continue an activity or process, especially after a pause or interruption.

words.tr: phrase. 仔细检查；复习；重做；转向；受欢迎
words.ex: I will go over my homework tonight.
words.ex_cn: 我今晚会复习我的家庭作业。
words.en: To examine or review something carefully; to cross over something.

words.ex: He will hand in his homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天交作业。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or a document.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

words.ex: If only I had more time, I would finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 要是我有更多时间，我就能完成作业了。
words.en: used to express a wish that something had happened differently or that something would happen

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: In addition to apples, he buys oranges.
words.ex_cn: 除了苹果，他还买橘子。
words.en: Besides; as well as.

words.ex: Please pay in advance.
words.ex_cn: 请提前付款。
words.en: Before a particular time, or before doing a particular thing.

words.ex: Take an umbrella in case it rains.
words.ex_cn: 带把伞，以防下雨。
words.en: used to describe a situation where you do something in order to be prepared for a possible future event

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

words.ex: He is in favor of eating vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 他赞成吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you are in favor of something, you support it or agree with it.

words.tr: phrase. 向...表示敬意；为祝贺...
words.ex: They planted a tree in honor of her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 他们种了一棵树以纪念她的生日。
words.en: If something is arranged or happens in honor of a particular event or person, it is done to celebrate that event or to show respect and admiration for that person.

words.ex: He finished his homework in no time.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就完成了作业。
words.en: Very quickly or soon.

words.tr: phrase. 按次序的；合乎程序的；井然有序
words.ex: Please line up in order.
words.ex_cn: 请按次序排队。
words.en: In the correct sequence or arrangement; appropriate or required by the circumstances.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: He used honey in place of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他用蜂蜜代替了糖。
words.en: Instead of someone or something else.

words.ex: I helped him, and he gave me a gift in return.
words.ex_cn: 我帮了他，他送了我一份礼物作为回报。
words.en: If you do something in return for what someone else has done for you, you do it because they did that thing for you.

words.ex: He went to school in spite of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: You use in spite of to introduce a fact which makes the rest of the statement you are making seem surprising.

words.ex: He is late in that he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为他没赶上公交车。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation for something.

words.ex: He acted in the name of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他以正义的名义行动。
words.en: If you do something in the name of a particular cause or principle, you do it in order to support that cause or principle.

words.ex: The box is in the way.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子挡路了。
words.en: If something or someone is in the way, they prevent you from moving or from doing something.

words.ex: His social life got in the way of his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他的社交生活妨碍了他的学习。
words.en: Concerning or in the matter of; with regard to.

words.ex: He arrived in time for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他赶上了公交车。
words.en: If you say that something will happen in time or given time, you mean that it will happen eventually, after a lot of time has passed.

words.tr: phrase. 依次；轮流；结果；反过来
words.ex: The students spoke in turn to answer the teacher's question.
words.ex_cn: 学生们依次回答老师的问题。
words.en: You use in turn to refer to actions or events that are in a sequence one after the other, especially because one causes the other.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: In place of someone or something else.

words.ex: Can you join in the game?
words.ex_cn: 你能加入这个游戏吗？
words.en: If you join in an activity, you take part in it or become involved in it.

words.ex: He runs just as fast as his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得和他哥哥一样快。
words.en: in the same way that; at the same time as

words.tr: phrase. 使留在里面；关住；抑制（感情等）；使（学生）课后留校
words.ex: Please keep in touch with us.
words.ex_cn: 请与我们保持联系。
words.en: To maintain something in a particular state or condition; to continue to have or hold something.

words.tr: phrase. 漫游；漂泊；闲逛；随意地击打或碰撞
words.ex: We just knock about the house on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们周末只是在家里闲逛。
words.en: To travel or move around without a specific purpose or direction, often in a casual or aimless manner.

words.tr: phrase. 把（钉子、螺栓等）敲进去；击入；在板球中使（跑垒员）得分
words.ex: He used a hammer to knock in the nail.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子把钉子敲进去。
words.en: To strike something so that it becomes fixed in place, or to score a run in baseball by hitting the ball so that a runner can reach home plate.

words.ex: He knocked out the other player in the boxing match.
words.ex_cn: 他在拳击比赛中击倒了另一名选手。
words.en: To knock someone out means to cause them to become unconscious or to defeat them in a competition.

words.tr: phrase. 撞倒；打翻；抢劫（商店等）；使震惊
words.ex: The dog knocked over the vase and broke it.
words.ex_cn: 狗把花瓶撞倒了，打碎了。
words.en: To cause something to fall or topple by striking it.

words.tr: phrase. 使怀孕；匆匆做成；敲门叫醒；快速准备（食物等）
words.ex: He knocked up the door with his hand.
words.ex_cn: 他用手敲了门。
words.en: To make someone pregnant; to prepare something quickly and often not very carefully.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.tr: phrase. 使失望；辜负；放下；降低
words.ex: He let down his team by missing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他因为没参加比赛而让队友失望了。
words.en: To fail to support or help someone as they had hoped or expected.

words.ex: Please let in the cat when it starts to rain.
words.ex_cn: 当下雨时，请让猫进来。
words.en: To allow someone or something to enter a place.

words.ex: He let out a loud scream.
words.ex_cn: 他大喊了一声。
words.en: To allow something to escape or be released; to reveal something that was supposed to be kept secret; to rent out property.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.ex_cn: 他仔细地看着这幅画。
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: He looks for his keys every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都找他的钥匙。
words.en: To search for something or someone.

words.ex: He made for the door when he heard the alarm.
words.ex_cn: 他听到警报后走向了门。
words.en: If something makes for a particular situation, it causes that situation to exist or develop.

words.tr: phrase. 理解；辨认出；书写；进展；设法应付；亲热
words.ex: I can't make out the words in this small print.
words.ex_cn: 我看不清这些小字。
words.en: to manage to see, hear, or understand someone or something with difficulty

words.tr: phrase. 翻新；改造；转让；移交
words.ex: He decided to make over his property to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他决定将他的财产转让给他的孩子们。
words.en: To change something completely, often so that it is better, or to transfer the legal possession of property to someone else.

words.tr: phrase. 确保；确定；核实；查明
words.ex: Make sure you lock the door before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前确保锁好门。
words.en: To make certain that something is done or happens.

words.tr: phrase. 编造；组成；弥补；化妆；和好
words.ex: He made up a story to explain his delay.
words.ex_cn: 他编了一个故事来解释他的迟到。
words.en: To make up means to form something by combining or assembling parts, to invent a story or excuse, to apply cosmetics, or to reconcile after a disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 既不……也不……；两者都不
words.ex: Neither Tom nor Anna likes coffee.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和安娜都不喜欢咖啡。
words.en: used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the others being introduced by 'nor') to indicate that they are each untrue or each do not happen.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.ex: No sooner had he arrived than the meeting started.
words.ex_cn: 他一到，会议就开始了。
words.en: used to say that something happens immediately after something else

words.ex: Now that it is sunny, we can go outside.
words.ex_cn: 既然天晴了，我们可以出去了。
words.en: Used to introduce a reason or explanation, often implying that the situation has changed.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: On the average, they work 40 hours per week.
words.ex_cn: 平均而言，他们每周工作40小时。
words.en: When you say 'on the average', you are referring to the mean value or the typical case in a set of data or a group of people.

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 陆续地；一个接一个地
words.ex: The children left the room one after another.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们一个接一个地离开了房间。
words.en: If things happen one after another, they happen in sequence, with little or no time in between.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.ex: He is out of favor with the management after the incident.
words.ex_cn: 事件发生后，他不再受管理层的欢迎。
words.en: No longer liked or supported by someone.

words.ex: He will pass on the message to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会把消息转告给他的朋友。
words.en: To give something to someone else, especially after receiving it or using it; to continue moving forward; to die.

words.tr: phrase. 还清；得到回报；取得成功
words.ex: He worked hard and finally paid off his debt.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作，终于还清了债务。
words.en: If something you have done pays off, it is successful or brings a good result.

words.tr: phrase. 搁置一旁；保留；储存...备用
words.ex: He put aside his money for the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱存起来用于旅行。
words.en: To place something to one side; to save something for future use.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr: phrase. 投入；使处于某种状态；用…表达
words.ex: He put his toys into the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把玩具放进盒子里。
words.en: To place something inside something else or to invest time, effort, or resources into something.

words.tr: phrase. 实施；使生效；付诸实行
words.ex: The new rules will be put into effect next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将于下周一实施。
words.en: To cause something to start to apply or operate.

words.ex: He put off his homework until tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业推迟到明天。
words.en: To delay something or to cause someone to feel dislike or lack of interest.

words.tr: phrase. 穿戴；上演；增加（体重）
words.ex: He puts on his coat before going out.
words.ex_cn: 他出门前穿上外套。
words.en: To put on something means to dress oneself in it, or to start wearing it. It can also mean to produce a play, show, or other performance. Additionally, it can refer to gaining weight or to pretend to have a particular feeling or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 举起；张贴；建造；进行；提供；推举；提供食宿
words.ex: He put up his hand to ask a question.
words.ex_cn: 他举起了手来提问。
words.en: To provide someone with a place to stay temporarily; to build or erect something; to raise or lift something; to propose or suggest something; to display or post something; to increase the price of something.

words.ex: This story relates to childhood memories.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事与童年的回忆有关。
words.en: If you relate to someone or something, you feel that you understand them or their feelings or ideas.

words.ex: He left right away when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他一听到消息就离开了。
words.en: If you do something right away, you do it immediately.

words.ex: He runs in the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上在公园跑步。
words.en: To drive a new car carefully for a certain distance or period of time in order to make sure that all its parts work correctly together; to visit someone informally.

words.ex: We ran out of milk this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我们今天早上牛奶喝完了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.tr: phrase. 碾过；溢出；匆匆浏览；超过（时间、数量等）
words.ex: The car ran over a small stone on the road.
words.ex_cn: 汽车碾过了路上的一块小石头。
words.en: To hit someone or something with a vehicle and drive over them; to quickly look through or read something; to overflow.

words.tr: phrase. v. 迅速累积（债务、账单等）；匆匆赶制；升起（旗帜等）；助跑
words.ex: He ran up a big bill at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店里赊账欠下了一大笔钱。
words.en: To accumulate or increase something, especially debts or costs, quickly.

words.tr: phrase. 接近（某个时间或事件）；持续到；高达（某一数额）
words.ex: The child can run up to the park every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子每天早上都能跑到公园。
words.en: To approach or reach a particular point in time or event; to accumulate.

words.ex: We went to the station to see off our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们去车站为朋友送行。
words.en: To accompany someone to the point of departure, such as an airport, train station, etc., as a gesture of farewell.

words.ex: I will see to the children while you are away.
words.ex_cn: 你不在的时候，我会照看孩子们。
words.en: To attend to or take care of something.

words.tr: phrase. 出发；动身；使爆炸；引起
words.ex: He set off early to avoid traffic.
words.ex_cn: 他早早出发以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: To begin a journey or to cause something to start or happen.

words.ex: He likes to show off his new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢炫耀他的新自行车。
words.en: If someone shows off, they behave in a way that is intended to attract attention and impress people, often by displaying their abilities or possessions.

words.ex: He did not show up for class yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天没有来上课。
words.en: If someone shows up, they arrive somewhere, especially unexpectedly or after they have been waiting a long time.

words.tr: phrase. 以便；为了（通常后接 to do，构成 so as to 表目的）
words.ex: He studied hard so as to pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，以便通过考试。
words.en: used to indicate the purpose of an action

words.ex: You can go out so long as you finish your homework.
words.ex_cn: 只要你做完作业，就可以出去。
words.en: provided that; on condition that

words.ex: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以便通过考试。
words.en: Used to introduce a clause of purpose or result.

words.ex: I will call you sometime next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周某个时候给你打电话。
words.en: At some unspecified or unknown time.

words.ex: He solved the math problem step by step.
words.ex_cn: 他一步一步地解出了这道数学题。
words.en: Proceeding gradually from one stage to the next.

words.tr: phrase. 假设；假定（引导条件或让步状语从句）
words.ex: Suppose that it rains tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 假设明天下雨。
words.en: To assume or accept something as true without proof; to think it likely.

words.tr: phrase. 拿回；收回；取消；使回忆起
words.ex: I will take back my book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我会从图书馆拿回我的书。
words.en: To take something back means to return something to the place it came from, or to admit that something you said was wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 拆卸；拆毁；记录；记下；笔录；取下
words.ex: He took down the old photo from the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把墙上的旧照片取了下来。
words.en: To write something down, especially in order to remember or record it; to remove something from a high position; to dismantle or disassemble something.

words.tr: phrase. 吸收；领会；接待；接受
words.ex: Plants take in sunlight to make food.
words.ex_cn: 植物吸收阳光来制造食物。
words.en: To take something in means to understand it or to absorb it. It can also mean to deceive someone or to make clothes smaller.

words.ex: The teacher took into account his effort, not just his grade.
words.ex_cn: 老师重视他的努力，而不仅仅是他的分数。
words.en: To consider or remember something when judging a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 呈现；承担；接受；较量；雇用
words.ex: The sky takes on a pink color at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时，天空呈现出粉红色。
words.en: To undertake or begin to deal with a task or responsibility; to hire someone; to acquire a particular appearance or quality.

words.tr: phrase. 拿出；取出；去掉；取得；领到
words.ex: He took out his keys to open the door.
words.ex_cn: 他拿出钥匙开门。
words.en: To remove something from a place or to take something with you when you go somewhere.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: Computers can take the place of typewriters.
words.ex_cn: 计算机可以取代打字机。
words.en: To take the place of something or someone means to replace them or to be used instead of them.

words.tr: phrase. 拿起；开始从事；接受（提议）；占用
words.ex: He took up the book from the table.
words.ex_cn: 他从桌子上拿起了书。
words.en: To begin to do or deal with something; to occupy or fill a particular amount of time or space; to accept an offer or challenge.

words.ex: I think about my future every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天都会思考我的未来。
words.en: To consider or reflect on something.

words.tr: phrase. 整理；收拾干净；使整洁
words.ex: He will tidy up the room after breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐后会收拾房间。
words.en: To make a place neat and orderly by removing clutter and arranging things properly.

words.tr: phrase. 上床睡觉；上交；告发；交还
words.ex: It's late, so I'll turn in now.
words.ex_cn: 很晚了，我现在上床睡觉。
words.en: To give something to someone in authority, especially a piece of work or something that is lost.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.ex_cn: 他打开了房间的灯。
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；生产；结果是；关闭；朝外
words.ex: The weather turned out to be sunny.
words.ex_cn: 天气结果是晴朗的。
words.en: If something turns out a particular way, it happens in that way or has the result or degree of success indicated. If you turn out something, you produce or create it. If you turn out a light, you switch it off.

words.tr: phrase. 翻转；移交；换台；营业额达到；反复考虑
words.ex: He turned over the pancake with a spatula.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子把煎饼翻了个面。
words.en: To cause something to move so that a different side is facing upwards; to transfer or hand over something to someone else; to achieve a certain amount of business.

words.tr: phrase. 突然出现；重新露面；调大
words.ex: He didn't turn up to the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他没有出席会议。
words.en: To arrive or appear somewhere, often unexpectedly; to increase the volume or intensity of something.

words.tr: phrase. 轻松地；毫不费力地
words.ex: He solves math problems with ease.
words.ex_cn: 他轻松地解决数学问题。
words.en: If you do something with ease, you do it easily, without difficulty.

words.tr: 短语. 生效；有效；自某时起实施
words.ex: The new rules will come into force with effect from next Monday.
words.ex_cn: 新规则将从下周一生效。
words.en: used to indicate that something will start to apply or be valid from a particular time

words.tr: phrase. 从事于…；继续工作；设法说服；影响
words.ex: He works on his homework every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都做家庭作业。
words.en: To spend time repairing or improving something.
